verdict.line: You lose if you stand in Snip Snip! range and trade autos while her passive heals her back; you win if you force all-ins while Hallowed Mist and Skip 'n Slash are both down.

brief.thesis: Gwen's only poke and only escape both live on long cooldowns — Snip Snip! resets fast (6.5s down to 3.5s at max rank) but Hallowed Mist sits at 22-18s and Skip 'n Slash only refreshes if she lands a hit during its buff window. Riven has no ranged tool before level 6, so every trade before then is decided by whether you eat a Q snip closing distance or block it with E (Valor). The matchup is genuinely even (48.2% over 226 games) because Gwen's passive sustain punishes long fights while Riven's burst punishes short ones — whoever dictates trade length wins lane.

theirWindow.when: she lands 2+ Snip Snip! stacks freely
theirWindow.what: Gwen is stacking A Thousand Cuts and healing off the magic damage tick — disengage rather than trade autos back, since she outlasts an extended exchange.

yourWindow.when: her W and E are both on cooldown
yourWindow.what: She has no disengage and no gap-closer for over 10 seconds. Dive with Q (Broken Wings) into W (Ki Burst) stun into E (Valor) to close the last step, then auto through the stun.

start.why: 94.8% pick rate at 48.6% win over 255 games — the extra sustain and AD matter because you're absorbing Snip Snip! chip while closing distance every trade.

boots.why: 64.2% pick, 50.9% win — the ability haste shortens your E (Valor) and W (Ki Burst) cooldowns, which is what lets you re-engage after she resets with Skip 'n Slash.

core.why: 58.6% win over 29 games as the lead item — the omnivamp and burst proc punish her for standing in melee range to land her cone snips.
Sustained in the top two build paths (58.6% and 65.2% win) — the true-damage-adjacent healing offsets her passive lifesteal in prolonged skirmishes.
Closes out both top paths — the damage-over-time conversion directly counters her burst snip windows and keeps you alive through her passive ticks.

runes.keystoneWhy: The stacking adaptive force and healing directly answer her passive lifesteal — you need sustain to win the extended trades that happen when you can't burst her down in one all-in window.

summoners.why: 97% pick rate at 49.8% win — Ignite removes her main sustain tool (the A Thousand Cuts heal) during your all-in windows, which is the deciding factor in a matchup this even.

playing.title: Block the center snip with E
playing.detail: Valor steps you forward while blocking incoming damage — use it specifically to eat the true-damage center hit of Snip Snip! when closing distance, not as a poke tool.

playing.title: Track her Skip 'n Slash refresh
playing.detail: If she dashes with E and whiffs the follow-up hit, the 13-11s cooldown doesn't refresh. That's over 10 seconds with no dash — your window to all-in.

playing.title: Never walk into her Mist
playing.detail: Hallowed Mist only lets enemies who enter it target her. Bait her to leave the mist to poke rather than diving in after her.

playing.title: Save all-ins for level 6
playing.detail: Blade of the Exile grants AD, range, and one Wind Slash cast — it's your only ranged answer to her kit and doubles as an execute on a poked-down Gwen.

playing.title: Cut trades short
playing.detail: A Thousand Cuts deals bonus magic damage on her autos and heals her — don't extend past your burst combo (Q-W-E-AA-AA), since she wins attrition fights.

playing.title: Punish overextensions with Ignite
playing.detail: She has no gap-closer beyond the short E dash. If she pushes past the halfway point of lane to land a snip, flash-in or all-in and Ignite to deny her sustain.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and win rates above are pulled from measured OP.GG games on the current patch (16.18.1); the mechanical reasoning and trade windows are my own read of the kits, not measured data.
